Do we mirror the client's voice, or hold to house style? The volume's rule: mirror where strong, default to house style where not. When the client's voice is not strong enough, default to UP (United Partners) house style and flag the gap: an unclear, jargon-heavy or inflated corporate voice is frequently a symptom of the reputation problem, not a neutral choice.

guided_interview.prompt: Read the Business audit findings and gaps below. Do the findings hold up on the client you know, and is any gap the one that would change how you walk into the client conversation?
findings: What the company does. Vivacom is a Bulgarian telecommunications provider serving households, businesses, and institutions (https://amcham.bg/member/vivacom/).

What the company does. Vivacom offers mobile voice, fixed voice, mobile broadband, fixed broadband, interactive TV, satellite TV, Internet of Things, smart-city, digital education, and cloud services (https://amcham.bg/member/vivacom/).

What the company does. Vivacom says it provides telecommunications solutions for private and business clients, including mobile and fixed voice, high-speed optical internet, satellite TV, interactive TV, and tailored offers for corporate clients (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).

What the company does. United Group describes Vivacom as a leading provider of mobile, fixed broadband, and television services in Bulgaria (https://united.group/united-group-backs-vivacoms-growth-as-bulgaria-telecoms-market-expands/).

What the company does. United Group said in 2020 that Vivacom was the first telecommunications company in Bulgaria and supplied fibre broadband, mobile communications, and digital TV to private and commercial customers (https://united.group/united-group-welcomes-vivacom-the-largest-telecom-operator-in-bulgaria/).
What the company does. Vivacom says its own infrastructure includes mobile, fixed, terrestrial, copper, and satellite assets (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).

What the company does. Vivacom says its 5G network covers 92% of Bulgaria’s population, its 4G LTE network covers 99.95%, and its 2G and 3G networks cover 99.99% (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).
What the company does. Vivacom says its fixed network covers 1.6 million homes and includes the first and only 10 GIGA network in Bulgaria (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).
What the company does. Vivacom says it has more than 200 own retail stores across Bulgaria (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).

Its business model. Vivacom serves both private and business customers with mobile and fixed voice, high-speed fixed broadband, mobile broadband, interactive TV, satellite TV, Internet of Things, smart-city, digital education, and cloud services (https://amcham.bg/member/vivacom/).

Its business model. Vivacom’s revenue model is a telecom bundle model built around mobile, fixed broadband, fixed voice, pay TV, devices, business services, and public-sector solutions (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata; https://amcham.bg/member/vivacom/).

Its business model. United Group says Vivacom has backed the shift to IPTV through EON, a TV product developed by United Cloud, and that IPTV has passed one million households nationally (https://united.group/united-group-backs-vivacoms-growth-as-bulgaria-telecoms-market-expands/).

Its business model. Netcracker says Vivacom uses Netcracker Revenue Management for billing, invoicing, and other revenue-related processes across postpaid mobile and fixed lines for B2C and B2B customers (https://www.netcracker.com/news/press-releases/netcracker-and-vivacom-extend-long-term-partnership-for-innovative-it-modernization-program).

Its business model. United Group completed the acquisition of Bulsatcom in February 2024, adding a direct-to-home satellite TV and broadband internet business in Bulgaria to the group’s Bulgarian perimeter (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/united-group-compretes-the-acquisition-of-bulsatcom).

Its performance. Vivacom says it has invested nearly BGN 3 billion in technology, innovation, human resources, and the Bulgarian economy; this pass found no independent source that restates the full BGN 3 billion figure (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).

Its performance. Vivacom says more than 2 million customers use more than 5.5 million services from the company; this pass found no independent source that restates those exact customer and service counts (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).

Its performance. CRC’s 2024 Annual Report says Vivacom held 37.1% of fixed Internet access retail revenue in 2024, up 8.3 percentage points from 2023 (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf).
Its performance. CRC’s 2024 Annual Report notes that Bulsatcom EOOD was incorporated into Vivacom Bulgaria EAD as of 10 July 2024 (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf).

Its performance. United Group said on 15 July 2026 that Bulgaria’s telecom market grew close to 5% in the prior year to EUR 2.16 billion and that market Internet revenue rose more than 9% to EUR 1.21 billion (https://united.group/united-group-backs-vivacoms-growth-as-bulgaria-telecoms-market-expands/).

Its performance. United Group said on 15 July 2026 that Vivacom grew its mobile service-revenue share over the prior year (https://united.group/united-group-backs-vivacoms-growth-as-bulgaria-telecoms-market-expands/).

Its performance. United Group said in 2020 that Vivacom had been Bulgaria’s largest domestic operator by revenue for the previous seven years (https://united.group/united-group-welcomes-vivacom-the-largest-telecom-operator-in-bulgaria/).
Its leadership. Vivacom’s management page names Asen Velikov as member of the management board and chief executive officer (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/ekip).

Its leadership. United Group’s leadership page says Asen Velikov is both chief executive officer and chief financial officer of Vivacom, joined the company in 1999, became chief financial officer in 2013, and has been a management-board member since 2014 (https://united.group/leadership/asen-velikov/).
Its leadership. Vivacom’s management page names Nikolay Gavrilov as management-board member and chief technical officer (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/ekip).

Its leadership. Vivacom’s management page names Stoyan Karanlakov as management-board member and chief commercial officer, with the role taken on 15 September 2021 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/ekip).
Its leadership. Vivacom’s management page names Ognyan Toshmakov as management-board member and chief financial officer from 13 July 2026 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/ekip).
Its leadership. Vivacom’s management page names Ivo Zlatev as management-board member and chief legal officer, in that role since 2017 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/ekip).

Its leadership. SeeNews reported on 5 August 2025 that United Group appointed Asen Velikov as CEO, replacing Nikolai Andreev, who was dismissed (https://seenews.com/news/bulgarias-vivacom-names-ceo-1279653).

Its leadership. SeeNews reported that Stan Miller was named chair of Vivacom’s supervisory board, Spas Rusev and Stan Miller were appointed as new board members, and Nikolaos Statopoulos was re-elected for five years (https://seenews.com/news/bulgarias-vivacom-names-ceo-1279653).
Its ownership. Vivacom says it has been part of United Group since 2020 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).

Its ownership. United Group says it completed the acquisition of Vivacom on 31 July 2020 after European Commission approval in April 2020 and a signed agreement in November 2019 (https://united.group/united-group-welcomes-vivacom-the-largest-telecom-operator-in-bulgaria/).

Its ownership. Schoenherr says the 2020 United Group acquisition of Vivacom was valued at EUR 1.2 billion and was Bulgaria’s largest 2019 deal by value and asset size (https://schoenherr.eu/content/bulgaria-schoenherr-advises-united-group-on-eur-1-2-bln-acquisition-of-vivacom).

Its ownership. United Group says it is majority owned by BC Partners, and BC Partners says the group is majority owned by BC Partners (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/united-group-compretes-the-acquisition-of-bulsatcom; https://www.bcpartners.com/portfolio/united-group/).

Its ownership. Vivacom says it is the successor to BTC, the first telecommunications company in Bulgaria, and says BTC moved from a long state-owned period to privatization in 2004 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).

Its ownership. Private Equity International reported that Advent’s 2004 BTC agreement covered a EUR 230 million purchase price plus a EUR 50 million capital increase (https://www.privateequityinternational.com/advent-finally-wins-bulgarian-telco/).

Its ownership. A SeeNews telecom sector report says the 2004 privatization sale of a 65% BTC stake was formally completed in June 2004, with Vienna-registered Viva Ventures GmbH remitting EUR 280 million (https://cdn.seenews.com/reports/TELECOMMUNICATIONS_Telecommunications%20Sector%20-%20Bulgaria%20%282006%29.pdf).
Its ownership. The Bulgarian Industrial Association reported that NEF Telecom Bulgaria sold a 93.99% stake in Vivacom to Viva Telecom Bulgaria in 2012 (https://en.bia-bg.com/service/view/14419/).

Its ownership. Developing Telecoms reported that Vivacom was sold at auction in November 2015 for about EUR 730 million (https://developingtelecoms.com/telecom-business/operator-news/6155-bulgarian-operator-vivacom-acquired-at-auction-for-730m.html).

Recent news. United Group said on 15 July 2026 that it would keep backing Vivacom’s investment in fibre, 5G, and EON as Bulgaria’s telecom market expanded (https://united.group/united-group-backs-vivacoms-growth-as-bulgaria-telecoms-market-expands/).

Recent news. Netcracker announced on 11 February 2026 that Vivacom extended its long-term partnership for an IT modernization program and would upgrade to the latest Netcracker Revenue Management platform (https://www.netcracker.com/news/press-releases/netcracker-and-vivacom-extend-long-term-partnership-for-innovative-it-modernization-program).

Recent news. SeeNews reported on 18 May 2026 that United Group was considering selling some or all Bulgarian assets, including Vivacom’s fixed network and Nova Broadcasting Group; this was reported as a media report, not as a confirmed United Group announcement (https://seenews.com/news/see-focused-united-group-mulls-selling-bulgarian-assets-report-1294890).

Recent news. Vivacom published an 8 August 2025 item showing Asen Velikov in the public CEO role during a meeting with summer interns (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/stazhantite-na-vivacom-v-razgovor-s-glavniya-izpalnitelen-direktor-asen-velikov).
Recent news. SeeNews reported on 5 August 2025 that United Group appointed Asen Velikov as CEO and changed Vivacom’s supervisory board (https://seenews.com/news/bulgarias-vivacom-names-ceo-1279653).

Recent news. United Group completed the Bulsatcom acquisition on 27 February 2024, and CRC’s 2024 Annual Report says Bulsatcom EOOD was incorporated into Vivacom Bulgaria EAD on 10 July 2024 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/united-group-compretes-the-acquisition-of-bulsatcom; https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf).

Its annual report or investor materials. Vivacom has public integrated annual reports on its own site, including the 2019 Integrated Report and a 2020 web report; this pass did not find a newer Vivacom stand-alone annual report page (https://www.vivacom.bg/bg/files/17826-integrated-report-2019.pdf; https://www.vivacom.bg/web/catalog/sustainableen/index.html).

Its annual report or investor materials. United Group has an investor site with sections for quarterly reports, annual reports, presentations, shareholder structure, bonds, and credit rating, but the fetched public HTML did not expose the report files in this pass (https://investors.united.group/).

Its annual report or investor materials. United Group’s 9M 2025 investor news says revenue increased 3% year on year to EUR 2.0 billion, last-twelve-month revenue reached EUR 2.7 billion, adjusted EBITDAal grew 7% to about EUR 680 million, and last-twelve-month adjusted EBITDAal reached EUR 909 million (https://united.group/united-group-b-v-continues-to-deliver-strong-growth-in-the-third-quarter-of-2025/).

Its annual report or investor materials. United Group’s 2023 results release says the group delivered EUR 2.791 billion of revenue, EUR 988 million of EBITDAal, a 35% EBITDAal margin, and year-end net debt to adjusted EBITDAal of 4.20x (https://united.group/united-group-b-v-continues-successful-growth-path-in-2023-with-record-results/).

Engagement trigger. The supplied brief says the engagement is a corporate brand and corporate communications strategy from a blank slate, with no approved corporate brand strategy, positioning, narrative, or pillar architecture in place (sanitized-telecom-blank-slate-brief.md). (bears on: the ask itself -- what is wanted, who decides, how success is defined)

Strategic business setting. The supplied brief says Vivacom is stable and profitable but works in a mature, saturated, price-pressured market where the three main operators have moved toward similar claims (sanitized-telecom-blank-slate-brief.md). (bears on: Business problem / organizational objective)

Self-claim verdict. Vivacom calls itself "Vivacom е иноватор"; AmCham independently confirms the breadth of the offer but does not verify the word innovator (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata; https://amcham.bg/member/vivacom/). (bears on: Reputation problem / desired perception)

Network proof guardrail. Vivacom says its 5G network has "най-голямо покритие в България"; United Group independently says it developed the country’s largest 5G network after entering Bulgaria in 2020, so the coverage claim is corroborated at group level (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata; https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/united-group-compretes-the-acquisition-of-bulsatcom). (bears on: Constraints and guardrails -- what cannot be said, claimed or processed)

Fixed-network claim. Vivacom says its fixed fibre network is "най-бързата оптична мрежа в България" and points to CRC tariff-comparison data dated 23 May 2025; this pass did not independently reproduce the CRC comparison output, so the exact speed ranking needs proof capture before use in client text (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata). (bears on: Baseline data & measurement access)

Municipal customer base. Vivacom says it works with more than 130 Bulgarian municipalities through smart-city services, which bears on public-sector and local-government audiences (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata). (bears on: Priority audiences & current state)

CSR proof pool. Vivacom says it has donated more than BGN 6 million over 15 years for more than 300 causes and more than 200 organizations; this is a CSR proof pool, but this pass did not find an independent public tally for those figures (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata). (bears on: Programme, narrative and channels -- the story, the spokespeople, what has worked)

What the company does. SeeNews says Vivacom provides professional internet and data services, radio and television data transfer, leased lines, VoIP, and public payphones, in addition to fixed-line telephony, mobile communications, internet, and digital TV (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525).

What the company does. Vivacom’s 2018 Annual Activities Report says Vivacom develops, operates, and maintains national fixed and mobile networks and a data system for Bulgaria (https://www.vivacom.bg/web/files/financial_reports/95/document/Vivacom_report_2018.pdf). The same report says Vivacom owned Plana teleport, serving orbital positions in Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and Asia (https://www.vivacom.bg/web/files/financial_reports/95/document/Vivacom_report_2018.pdf).

What the company does. Vivacom’s 2018 Annual Activities Report says NURTS Group was a Vivacom-owned provider of radio and television broadcasting, terrestrial and satellite signal transmission, and colocation services in Bulgaria (https://www.vivacom.bg/web/files/financial_reports/95/document/Vivacom_report_2018.pdf). The same report says NURTS Group owned and operated more than 500 radio and television stations across Bulgaria (https://www.vivacom.bg/web/files/financial_reports/95/document/Vivacom_report_2018.pdf).

What the company does. SeeNews says Vivacom owned and operated the Plana Teleport satellite facility with 40 antennae at the end of 2016 (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525).

Its business model. SeeNews says Vivacom provides fixed-line telephony, mobile communications, internet, professional internet and data services, radio and television data transfer, leased lines, VoIP, public payphones, and digital TV (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525).

Its business model. CRC says 6,415,737 mobile voice subscribers in Bulgaria used the service in a package with other electronic communications services at 31 December 2024, equal to 80.4% of mobile voice subscribers (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf). CRC’s Vivacom market-share tables for fixed internet, mobile internet, and pay TV count subscribers and revenue from bundled services, which confirms that bundled access is central to the market model Vivacom competes in (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf).

Its business model. Broadband TV News reported on 17 March 2026 that Vivacom added BBC First and BBC Earth to EON in Bulgaria (https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2026/03/17/vivacom-adds-bbc-first-and-bbc-earth-to-eon-in-bulgaria/). Broadband TV News reported that BBC First was added to EON Premium and BBC Earth to EON Full and EON Premium, showing package-tier content as part of the TV offer (https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2026/03/17/vivacom-adds-bbc-first-and-bbc-earth-to-eon-in-bulgaria/).

Its business model. SeeNews says Vivacom signed a EUR 1.5 million deal with Burgas municipality in March 2020 for video-surveillance upgrade and expansion (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525). SeeNews says Vivacom and Bulgaria’s labour ministry signed 10 telecommunications-service contracts worth BGN 1.75 million in October 2019 (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525).

Its performance. SeeNews lists Vivacom Bulgaria EAD’s 2024 revenue as BGN 1,429,290,000, 2024 profit as BGN 234,941,000, 2024 assets as BGN 2,693,006,000, and employees as 4,756 (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525).

Its performance. CRC says Vivacom held second place in Bulgarian retail mobile voice in 2024 by both subscribers and revenue (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf). CRC says Vivacom’s mobile voice revenue share rose from 25.4% in 2020 to 32.0% in 2024 (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf). CRC says Vivacom was the only mobile operator whose subscriber share increased every year from 2020 to 2024, adding 4.3 percentage points over the period (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf).

Its performance. CRC says Vivacom held 56.5% of fixed voice lines and 82.2% of fixed voice subscriber revenue in 2024 (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf). CRC says Vivacom was the only undertaking declaring public payphone activity in 2024 (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf).

Its performance. CRC says Vivacom held 36.7% of retail mobile internet access subscribers and 28.2% of mobile internet access revenue in 2024 (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf). CRC says A1 remained the mobile internet revenue leader with 42.1% in 2024 (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf).

Its performance. CRC says Vivacom held 59.6% of Bulgarian retail pay-TV subscribers and 56.5% of pay-TV revenue in 2024 (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf). CRC says Vivacom’s pay-TV shares grew mainly because Bulsatcom and TVN Distribution Bulgaria were incorporated into Vivacom (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf).

Its performance. Vivacom’s 2018 Annual Activities Report says it served 3.071 million mobile subscribers, 689,000 fixed telephony subscribers, 444,000 fixed broadband subscribers, and 468,000 fixed pay-TV subscribers at 31 December 2018 (https://www.vivacom.bg/web/files/financial_reports/95/document/Vivacom_report_2018.pdf).

Its leadership. United Group’s 28 July 2026 H1 operations update says Vivacom CEO Asen Velikov joined European business leaders in launching the Sofia Initiative, which called for more investment in digital infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and next-generation connectivity across Europe (https://united.group/updates-from-united-groups-operations-h1-2026/).

Its leadership. United Group appointed Janet Zaharieva as Group Director Public Policy and Corporate Affairs while she also remains Chief Public Policy and European Affairs at Vivacom (https://united.group/united-group-strengthens-its-leadership-team/). United Group says Zaharieva has 28 years in communications, media, and ICT, and has been part of Vivacom leadership since 2010 (https://united.group/united-group-strengthens-its-leadership-team/).

Its ownership. SeeNews lists Vivacom Bulgaria EAD’s direct owner as Slovenia Broadband SARL with a 100% direct holding (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525). SeeNews lists Slovenia Broadband SARL as a Luxembourg company (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525).

Its ownership. SeeNews says United Group Bulgaria EOOD became the sole owner on 20 July 2022 (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525). SeeNews says Slovenia Broadband SARL acquired 100% of Bulgarian Telecommunications Company EAD on 13 September 2022 (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525). SeeNews says the company changed its name to Vivacom Bulgaria EAD on 5 October 2022 (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525).

Its ownership. SeeNews says Vivacom took over Telco Infrastructures, Networks Bulgaria, TVN Distribuition Bulgaria, and Online Direct on 5 March 2024 (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525). SeeNews says Extremenet, Internet Group, Powernet, and Bulsatcom Sales merged into Vivacom Bulgaria EAD on 9 August 2024 (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525). SeeNews says United Fiber Bulgaria spun off from Vivacom and became an independent legal entity on 13 August 2024 (https://seenews.com/companies/profile/vivacom-bulgaria-ead-formerly-known-as-bulgarian-telecommunications-company-ead-4525).

Its ownership. Vivacom’s 2017 interim financial statements say Viva Telecom Bulgaria EOOD was the parent as of 30 June 2017 (https://www.vivacom.bg/web/files/financial_reports/88/document/Vivacom_report_Q2_2017.pdf). The same report says the largest shareholder in VTL was Viva Edge Telecom Limited with 46%, ultimately owned by Spas Roussev (https://www.vivacom.bg/web/files/financial_reports/88/document/Vivacom_report_Q2_2017.pdf). The same report names other minority investors affiliated with OJSC VTB Bank, Delta Capital Investments, Michael Tennenbaum, and companies managed by Mezzanine Management (https://www.vivacom.bg/web/files/financial_reports/88/document/Vivacom_report_Q2_2017.pdf).

Recent news. United Group’s 28 July 2026 H1 operations update says Vivacom delivered the Bulgarian pilot of Job Lab with 120 students across Sofia, Varna, Veliko Tarnovo, and Blagoevgrad (https://united.group/updates-from-united-groups-operations-h1-2026/). The same update says Vivacom completed the 16th edition of its Technical Academy with new artificial-intelligence and cybersecurity courses, ending in a Private 5G Hackathon (https://united.group/updates-from-united-groups-operations-h1-2026/). The same update says Vivacom welcomed 55 people to its latest Summer Internship Programme (https://united.group/updates-from-united-groups-operations-h1-2026/).

Recent news. United Group’s 28 July 2026 update says Vivacom GAME ON launched its first mobile game and that the first two YouTube episodes generated more than 87,000 views (https://united.group/updates-from-united-groups-operations-h1-2026/). The same update says Vivacom extended its partnership with the Association of Olympic Teams in Natural Sciences to 2028 and added a EUR 30,000 donation (https://united.group/updates-from-united-groups-operations-h1-2026/).

Recent news. Broadband TV News reported on 17 March 2026 that Vivacom added BBC First and BBC Earth to EON in Bulgaria (https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2026/03/17/vivacom-adds-bbc-first-and-bbc-earth-to-eon-in-bulgaria/). Broadband TV News reported that Vivacom had added more than 10 new channels across its TV platforms in recent months, including SkyShowtime, SkyShowtime 1, SkyShowtime 2, Arena Action, Arena Comedy, Arena Life, and Love Nature (https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2026/03/17/vivacom-adds-bbc-first-and-bbc-earth-to-eon-in-bulgaria/).

Recent news. Vivacom said on 18 December 2025, “Vivacom става първият телеком у нас, който предлага тази технология,” referring to FTTR and Wi-Fi 7 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/vivacom-startira-fftr-za-parvi-pat-v-bulgaria-i-postavya-optichnata-svarzanost-na-novo-nivo). United Group repeated the first-operator claim on 17 April 2026, but this pass did not find an independent public source that verified the first-operator ranking (https://united.group/updates-from-our-greek-and-bulgarian-operations/).

Its annual report or investor materials. Vivacom’s 2018 Annual Activities Report is public and says it covers Bulgarian Telecommunications Company EAD on both individual and consolidated bases for the year ended 31 December 2018 (https://www.vivacom.bg/web/files/financial_reports/95/document/Vivacom_report_2018.pdf). The 2018 report says the group generated BGN 948.0 million in consolidated revenue and BGN 359.8 million in consolidated adjusted EBITDA in 2018 (https://www.vivacom.bg/web/files/financial_reports/95/document/Vivacom_report_2018.pdf).

Its annual report or investor materials. Vivacom’s 2015 IFRS financial statements are public through the London Stock Exchange RNS PDF route (https://www.rns-pdf.londonstockexchange.com/rns/9170U_-2016-4-12.pdf). The 2015 statements say the group ended 2015 with BGN 16.5 million profit and had issued EUR 400 million 6.625% senior secured notes due 2018 (https://www.rns-pdf.londonstockexchange.com/rns/9170U_-2016-4-12.pdf).

Its annual report or investor materials. United Group’s ESG reporting page lists a downloadable 2024 sustainability report and ESG factsheet (https://united.group/sustainability-our-vision-esg-reporting/). United Group’s ESG factsheet table reports 2024 group total employees at year end of 15,465 and total employees FTE of 14,647 (https://united.group/sustainability-our-vision-esg-reporting/).

Group public affairs link. United Group appointed Janet Zaharieva as Group Director Public Policy and Corporate Affairs while she also remains Chief Public Policy and European Affairs at Vivacom; United Group says she has been part of Vivacom leadership since 2010 (https://united.group/united-group-strengthens-its-leadership-team/). findings: How much media coverage it gets. Rankings. InfobelPRO’s June 2026 directory ranked A1 Bulgaria EAD at USD 880 million revenue, Vivacom Bulgaria EAD at USD 775 million, and Yettel Bulgaria EAD at USD 566 million. (https://www.infobelpro.com/companies/bulgaria/telecom)

Past crises or live issues. On 30 January 2024, Bulgaria’s Ombudsman objected to Vivacom Bulgaria EAD’s planned 4.3% tariff indexation for another year. (https://www.ombudsman.bg/en/n/ombudsman-objects-to-new-indexation-of-mobile-service-tariffs-2198)

Past crises or live issues. The Ombudsman said the indexation practice was unfair and asked for immediate action to end it. (https://www.ombudsman.bg/en/n/ombudsman-objects-to-new-indexation-of-mobile-service-tariffs-2198)

Past crises or live issues. CRC’s 2024 annual report lists Decision No. 32 of 8 February 2024 as a dispute between a group of operators and Vivacom Bulgaria EAD. The annual report does not give the dispute detail in the passage found. (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf)

Past crises or live issues. On 29 January 2026, Sofia City Administrative Court rejected Vivacom’s appeal against a 15 July 2025 personal-data decision and left the Commission for Personal Data Protection decision standing. (https://search-sofia-adms-g.justice.bg/Acts/GetActContent?BlobID=037635ca-81cd-4778-bc7e-4a516c9c0a13)

Past crises or live issues. The 2026 Sofia court record says the data-protection decision imposed a BGN 100,000 sanction on Vivacom. (https://search-sofia-adms-g.justice.bg/Acts/GetActContent?BlobID=037635ca-81cd-4778-bc7e-4a516c9c0a13)

Past crises or live issues. The 2026 Sofia court record says four extra mobile-service contracts and device purchases were created using another person’s personal data linked to an existing customer number. (https://search-sofia-adms-g.justice.bg/Acts/GetActContent?BlobID=037635ca-81cd-4778-bc7e-4a516c9c0a13)

Past crises or live issues. The 2026 Sofia court record says Vivacom did not prove that the person had consented to the processing for those four contracts. (https://search-sofia-adms-g.justice.bg/Acts/GetActContent?BlobID=037635ca-81cd-4778-bc7e-4a516c9c0a13)

Past crises or live issues. CJEU case C-369/23 closed on 19 December 2024 after Vivacom sought damages tied to an alleged EU-law infringement in a VAT dispute. (https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX%3A62023CA0369)

Past crises or live issues. The CJEU held that a last-instance court may hear a case where it is a defendant only if safeguards remove reasonable doubt about independence and impartiality. (https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX%3A62023CA0369)

Risk-governance pattern. The banked record forms a risk-governance pattern: customer-law, data-protection, cyber, outage, competition, ownership-sale and parent-group issues are all present, so the first client conversation should test whether Legal, Regulatory Affairs, security and parent communications share one risk line. (banked findings: Consumer Protection Commission order; banked findings: data-protection sanctions; banked findings: cyberattack; banked findings: Varna network crash; banked findings: competition probe; banked finding: possible Bulgarian-asset sale.) (bears on: Decision-maker & approval path)

Three-player concentration. CRC says bundled services remained highly concentrated in 2024, with A1, Vivacom and Yettel holding more than 97.8% of that market. (https://crc.bg/files/Annual_Report_CRC_2024_EN.pdf) (bears on: Business problem / organizational objective)

Owned-web audience. Similarweb says 93.46% of vivacom.bg desktop traffic came from Bulgaria, the largest age group was 35-44, and the audience split was 53.71% male and 46.29% female. (https://www.similarweb.com/website/vivacom.bg/) (bears on: Priority audiences & current state)

United Group describes Vivacom as a “leader in digital connectivity, innovation and talent development”; this pass found support for named talent and skills programmes, but not independent proof of the broad leader claim. (https://united.group/updates-from-united-groups-operations-h1-2026/) (bears on: Reputation problem / desired perception)

findings: Channels. Vivacom runs its main owned site at vivacom.bg with customer login, My Vivacom access, product areas, help pages, coverage maps, shop finder, EON, Arena and support paths (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/ekip).

Channels. The public news centre publishes Bulgarian-language items across promotions, company news, social responsibility, internship programme and Vivacom GAME ON (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini).
Channels. The LinkedIn company page had 22,015 followers and described Vivacom as a telecom operator for private and business customers in Bulgaria (https://bg.linkedin.com/company/vivacom).
Channels. The official Facebook page search result showed 291,877 likes and described itself as the official Facebook page of Vivacom (https://www.facebook.com/VIVAC0M/).
Channels. Instagram account @vivacombg showed 55K followers, 69 following and 1,594 posts in search results (https://www.instagram.com/vivacombg/?hl=en).
Channels. The YouTube channel @VIVACOMOfficial showed 15.3K subscribers and about 1.4K videos in search results (https://www.youtube.com/%40VIVACOMOfficial).
Channels. The X account @vivacom is listed as Bulgaria-based, linked to vivacom.bg/bg/5g and joined on August 6, 2010 (https://x.com/vivacom?lang=en).

Channels. The My Vivacom app is present on Google Play and Apple App Store, giving Vivacom a service channel beyond social and web publishing (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en_IE&id=bg.vivacom.mobile; https://apps.apple.com/bg/app/my-vivacom/id1297193461).

Channels. Pikasa monitored Vivacom on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube in Q1 2026, and said TikTok presence was negligible across all three Bulgarian operators (https://pikasa.ai/post/149/the-platform-bet-how-bulgarian-telecoms-are-winning-and-losing-the-attention-war).
Presence. Vivacom says it has more than 2 million customers using more than 5.5 million services (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).
Presence. Vivacom says it has invested nearly 3 billion leva in technology, innovation, people and the Bulgarian economy (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).
Presence. Vivacom says it became part of United Group in 2020 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).

Presence. Pikasa tracked 134 Vivacom social posts in Q1 2026, with 15,770 total engagements and 118 average engagements per post (https://pikasa.ai/post/149/the-platform-bet-how-bulgarian-telecoms-are-winning-and-losing-the-attention-war).

Presence. Pikasa said Vivacom led press volume among A1, Vivacom and Yettel in Q1 2026 with 198 articles, but that most were PR announcements with near-zero audience response (https://pikasa.ai/post/149/the-platform-bet-how-bulgarian-telecoms-are-winning-and-losing-the-attention-war).

Presence. Pikasa said Instagram was Vivacom’s strongest platform in Q1 2026, averaging 327 engagements per post and forming the strongest platform-brand result in its dataset (https://pikasa.ai/post/149/the-platform-bet-how-bulgarian-telecoms-are-winning-and-losing-the-attention-war).

Presence. Pikasa said Vivacom averaged only 9 engagements per YouTube video in Q1 2026 despite reaching 130,000 average views per video, the highest YouTube reach in the sector (https://pikasa.ai/post/149/the-platform-bet-how-bulgarian-telecoms-are-winning-and-losing-the-attention-war).

Presence. The My Vivacom app was updated on Google Play on August 4, 2026, and the listing says it supports mobile, internet and TV service management, invoices, payment access, packages, EON profile settings, personalised online offers and support (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en_IE&id=bg.vivacom.mobile).

Presence. Gridinsoft detected vivacom.bg as an established 16.5-year-old domain with Google Tag Manager, social media links, multilingual support, structured page data and verified YouTube and X footprints; this is a technical signal, not a brand-performance measure (https://gridinsoft.com/online-virus-scanner/url/vivacom-bg).

Tone of voice. Vivacom’s corporate copy is in Bulgarian and often leads with scale, innovation and national role, as in the exact phrase “Vivacom е иноватор” (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).

Tone of voice. Vivacom’s corporate page says its mission is to give customers high-quality telecom services and the best experience, and its vision is to be the preferred telecom provider in Bulgaria (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata).

Tone of voice. Vivacom’s LinkedIn page uses Bulgarian, first-person plural language, emojis, student quotes and soft calls to read more, which makes the social voice warmer and more human than the official press voice (https://bg.linkedin.com/company/vivacom).

Tone of voice. Vivacom’s LinkedIn content in August 2026 centred on internships, forest-fire prevention, Job Lab, leadership training, Game ON and product offers (https://bg.linkedin.com/company/vivacom).

Tone of voice. Pikasa found Facebook focused mainly on devices and plans, LinkedIn on cybersecurity, university partnerships and smart-city projects, and YouTube mainly on short promotional clips (https://pikasa.ai/post/149/the-platform-bet-how-bulgarian-telecoms-are-winning-and-losing-the-attention-war).

Tone of voice. The news centre mix is highly commercial, with August 2026 items including smartphone offers, Samsung launches, online discounts, internships, GAME ON and cybersecurity training (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini).

Tone of voice. Vivacom’s 5G claim is proof-led in form: it names Ookla, the 417.27 Speed Score, 52,578 user tests and the July 1 to December 31, 2021 test period (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/vivacom-ima-nai-barzata-5g-mreja-v-bulgaria-spored-ookla).

Tone of voice. Telecompaper independently reported the same Ookla 5G result and 52,578 user-test basis, corroborating the speed claim while noting that the largest-network claim came from the operator (https://www.telecompaper.com/news/vivacom-named-fastest-5g-network-in-bulgaria-by-ookla--1410099).

Tone of voice. The My Vivacom app copy says it is “created with the customer in mind”; Google Play reviews and Apple App Store reviews challenge the experience with visible complaints about login, payment and reliability (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en_IE&id=bg.vivacom.mobile; https://apps.apple.com/bg/app/my-vivacom/id1297193461).

Community. Vivacom Regional Grant is described as the company’s largest public-benefit initiative, supporting education and environmental projects by civic organisations across Bulgaria (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/sotsialna-otgovornost).
Community. Vivacom says Regional Grant has supported 128 projects by 115 civic organisations with more than 700,000 leva since launch (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/sotsialna-otgovornost).

Community. Vivacom says Job Lab targets 11th and 12th grade students and develops soft and digital skills through school workshops, independent work and a visit to Vivacom headquarters with an AI and digital skills module (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/sotsialna-otgovornost).

Community. Vivacom says it has donated nearly 140,000 leva to Bulgarian science olympiad teams and gave 10,000 leva plus unlimited internet connectivity to the first International Olympiad in AI in Burgas in August 2024 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/sotsialna-otgovornost).
Community. Vivacom’s LinkedIn page said the 2026 summer internship included 55 young people selected from nearly 1,800 candidates (https://bg.linkedin.com/company/vivacom).

Community. Vivacom’s LinkedIn page said the pilot Job Lab gave 120 students from Sofia, Varna, Veliko Tarnovo and Blagoevgrad practical career and digital skills experience (https://bg.linkedin.com/company/vivacom).

Community. Vivacom’s LinkedIn page said the GAME ON 2026 mobile game had more than 3,000 players and the first two YouTube episodes had more than 87,000 views (https://bg.linkedin.com/company/vivacom).

Community. The My Vivacom Google Play listing had a 3.9 rating from 61.7K reviews and showed Vivacom replying to a user complaint on February 18, 2026 (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en_IE&id=bg.vivacom.mobile).

Community. The Bulgarian Apple App Store listing showed a 3.6 rating from 16K ratings, with visible complaints about app reliability and dated user interface (https://apps.apple.com/bg/app/my-vivacom/id1297193461).

Community. Trustpilot showed a 1.3 rating from 203 reviews and states that Vivacom has not invited reviews, so the sample should be treated as a warning signal rather than a full customer measure (https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.vivacom.bg).

The visibility of its executives. Vivacom’s management page names Asen Velikov as Management Board member and Chief Executive Officer, and says he joined the company in 1999, became Chief Financial Officer in 2013 and joined the Management Board in 2014 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/ekip).

The visibility of its executives. United Group’s leadership page also names Asen Velikov as Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer of Vivacom (https://united.group/leadership/asen-velikov/).

The visibility of its executives. SeeNews reported on August 5, 2025 that United Group appointed Asen Velikov as CEO of Vivacom, replacing Nikolai Andreev (https://seenews.com/news/bulgarias-vivacom-names-ceo-1279653).

The visibility of its executives. Economic.bg reported on August 4, 2025 that Nikolay Andreev was stepping down, Asen Velikov would temporarily take over as CEO, and Spas Rusev and Stanley Miller were joining the Supervisory Board (https://www.economic.bg/en/a/view/top-management-reshuffle-at-vivacom-director-leaves-spas-rusev-returns).

The visibility of its executives. Vivacom’s news centre carried 2025 and 2026 items about interns meeting Chief Executive Officer Asen Velikov, making the CEO visible through employer and talent content (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini).

The visibility of its executives. United Group said in July 2026 that Asen Velikov joined European business leaders in launching the Sofia Initiative on digital infrastructure, AI and next-generation connectivity (https://united.group/updates-from-united-groups-operations-h1-2026/).

The visibility of its executives. BTA reported that Vivacom CEO Asen Velikov presented Smart City certificates at the 13th Mayor of the Year Awards on October 7, 2025 (https://www.bta.bg/en/news/bulgaria/982827-city-leaders-of-ivaylovgrad-tundzha-yambol-named-mayor-of-2025).

The visibility of its executives. Vivacom’s LinkedIn page showed senior HR leader Malina Chavdarova quoted on manager development, talent support and a 24 Chasa interview, making non-CEO executives visible in employer content (https://bg.linkedin.com/company/vivacom).

The visibility of its executives. Vivacom’s management page names Janeta Zaharieva as Chief Adviser for State Policy and European Affairs, United Group Director for State Policy and Corporate Affairs, and a representative in Connect Europe and GSMA (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/ekip).

History and ownership. Vivacom says it is the successor to BTC, that BTC Mobile began selling mobile services under the vivatel brand in November 2005, that BTC and vivatel merged in 2009, and that the Vivacom brand was born in July 2009 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata). (bears on: business and organizational context)

History and ownership. United Group completed the acquisition of Vivacom on July 31, 2020, after European Commission approval in April 2020 and a signed agreement in November 2019 (https://united.group/united-group-welcomes-vivacom-the-largest-telecom-operator-in-bulgaria/). (bears on: decision-maker & approval path)

History and ownership. Reuters reported through Yahoo Finance that United Group agreed to buy Vivacom in a 1.2 billion euro deal, equal to about 1.3 billion dollars, on November 7, 2019 (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/1-united-group-buy-bulgarias-170942151.html). (bears on: business and organizational context)

Smart-city platform. Vivacom says it works on Internet of Things and smart-city services and has smart solutions for more than 130 Bulgarian municipalities (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata). (bears on: programme, narrative and channels)

Customer data exposure. The My Vivacom Google Play listing says the app may share personal information and may collect location, personal information and two other data types (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en_IE&id=bg.vivacom.mobile). (bears on: constraints and guardrails)

Self-claim verdict. Vivacom says, exactly, “Vivacom е иноватор” and says it has invested nearly 3 billion leva in technology, innovation, people and the Bulgarian economy; Pikasa did not test that exact innovation claim, but its Q1 2026 social audit found Vivacom strongest on Instagram and weak at converting YouTube reach into response (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata; https://pikasa.ai/post/149/the-platform-bet-how-bulgarian-telecoms-are-winning-and-losing-the-attention-war). (bears on: reputation problem / desired perception)

Self-claim verdict. Vivacom says its 5G network is the largest in Bulgaria and covers 92% of the population; OpenSignal’s January 2026 Bulgaria mobile report corroborated a related strength by awarding Vivacom the Time on 5G award with 26.3%, two percentage points ahead of A1 (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/za-kompaniyata; https://insights.opensignal.com/reports/2026/01/bulgaria/mobile-network-experience). (bears on: reputation and stakeholder context)

Channels. Vivacom GAME ON had a wider live-stream channel set than the banked 2026 YouTube evidence shows: in September 2024 the first two rounds were streamed in 9 online channels across YouTube, Twitch, Kick and TikTok (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/parvite-dva-runda-na-vivacom-game-on-s-blizo-180-000-gledania-online). In October 2025 a Roblox round was streamed in 11 channels across YouTube, Twitch, Kick and TikTok, so GAME ON uses creator and streaming channels beyond Vivacom's main owned social accounts (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/virtualniyat-svyat-na-roblox-otpravi-novo-izpitanie-za-otbornite-v-tretiya-onlain-rund-na-vivacom-game-on-2025).

Presence. The first two Vivacom GAME ON rounds in 2024 generated about 180,000 online views and more than 24,000 viewer hours, showing that the gaming platform can draw measurable audience attention outside ordinary telecom product posts (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/parvite-dva-runda-na-vivacom-game-on-s-blizo-180-000-gledania-online). The 2025 GAME ON YouTube series had more than 250,000 views after six episodes, according to Vivacom's own news centre; no independent source found in this pass tested that figure (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/virtualniyat-svyat-na-roblox-otpravi-novo-izpitanie-za-otbornite-v-tretiya-onlain-rund-na-vivacom-game-on-2025).

Presence. United Group said in July 2026 that Bulgaria's telecoms market reached 2.16 billion euros in the prior year and that IPTV had passed one million households nationally; this places Vivacom's EON presence inside a visible market shift toward IPTV (https://united.group/united-group-backs-vivacoms-growth-as-bulgarias-telecoms-market-expands/).

Tone of voice. Asen Velikov's 2019 interview used a customer-first and technology-change frame, calling Vivacom a "customer-oriented company" and saying customer experience had become a focus of investment because customers compare telecoms with Amazon and Google (https://www.economic.bg/bg/a/view/change-is-the-only-invariable-112562). This supports a voice route around customer experience and digital change, not only network scale (https://www.economic.bg/bg/a/view/change-is-the-only-invariable-112562).

Tone of voice. The Netcracker release carried a technical but customer-facing executive voice: Asen Velikov linked billing-system modernization to long-term stability, growth and the customer experience, while Netcracker framed the work around 5G monetization, AI, automation and vertical industries (https://www.netcracker.com/news/press-releases/netcracker-and-vivacom-extend-long-term-partnership-for-innovative-it-modernization-program).

Tone of voice. The GAME ON news voice is youth-culture and gaming-led, using named creators, Roblox, Minecraft, live streams, fan voting, prizes, finals and YouTube episodes to translate fibre-network proof into entertainment participation (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/parvite-dva-runda-na-vivacom-game-on-s-blizo-180-000-gledania-online; https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/virtualniyat-svyat-na-roblox-otpravi-novo-izpitanie-za-otbornite-v-tretiya-onlain-rund-na-vivacom-game-on-2025).

Community. The 2024 GAME ON format made viewers active participants: more than 100 audience-selected participants joined the second online battle, viewers voted in Vivacom's social channels, and the final carried a 15,000 leva prize fund (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/parvite-dva-runda-na-vivacom-game-on-s-blizo-180-000-gledania-online). In the 2025 Roblox round, two fans won 1,000 leva each and a chance to stand with their preferred captain at the November 1 final in Joy Station, Sofia (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/virtualniyat-svyat-na-roblox-otpravi-novo-izpitanie-za-otbornite-v-tretiya-onlain-rund-na-vivacom-game-on-2025).

Community. United Group said Job Lab began in Bosnia and Herzegovina in 2021, then expanded to Slovenia and Croatia before Bulgaria became the fourth market in 2026; this makes Vivacom's Job Lab a local version of a group youth-skills programme rather than a stand-alone Bulgarian invention (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/united-group-b.v._joblab-unitedgroup-vivacom-activity-7425125424449511424-1jtJ).

The visibility of its executives. Asen Velikov appears as a customer-experience and IT-modernization spokesperson beyond Vivacom's owned channels: Netcracker quoted him on February 11, 2026 saying Vivacom was entering the "next phase of our IT evolution" through its revenue-management upgrade (https://www.netcracker.com/news/press-releases/netcracker-and-vivacom-extend-long-term-partnership-for-innovative-it-modernization-program). This is partner-channel visibility tied to service systems and customer experience rather than only corporate announcements (https://www.netcracker.com/news/press-releases/netcracker-and-vivacom-extend-long-term-partnership-for-innovative-it-modernization-program).

The visibility of its executives. Asen Velikov had executive media visibility before becoming CEO: Economic.bg published a 2019 interview with him as Financial Director and Management Board member, covering customer experience, e-shop updates, customer-centre platform replacement, SAP, electronic sourcing and supplier relationship management (https://www.economic.bg/bg/a/view/change-is-the-only-invariable-112562).

The visibility of its executives. The banked record makes a new pattern visible: Asen Velikov is visible through owned Vivacom pages, parent-group pages, partner releases, employer content and public events, while the banked non-CEO executive visibility is mainly HR and public-affairs content (banked findings: The visibility of its executives).

EON platform provenance. United Group said in July 2026 that Vivacom backs Bulgaria's IPTV shift through EON, a TV platform developed by United Cloud; this adds parent-group platform provenance to Vivacom's entertainment story (https://united.group/united-group-backs-vivacoms-growth-as-bulgarias-telecoms-market-expands/). United Group separately says EON was built in-house by United Cloud and is available across the markets where United Group operates; Broadband TV News independently reported that Vivacom added BBC First and BBC Earth to EON in Bulgaria in March 2026, so the presence of EON in Vivacom's offer is corroborated while the parent claim that it is an "award-winning TV platform" was not tested there (https://united.group/united-group-brings-southeast-europes-leading-television-platform-eon-to-greece/; https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2026/03/17/vivacom-adds-bbc-first-and-bbc-earth-to-eon-in-bulgaria/). (bears on: programme, narrative and channels)

Customer and revenue systems. Netcracker said on February 11, 2026 that Vivacom would upgrade to the latest version of Netcracker Revenue Management as part of an IT modernization programme affecting postpaid mobile and fixed lines for both B2C and B2B customers (https://www.netcracker.com/news/press-releases/netcracker-and-vivacom-extend-long-term-partnership-for-innovative-it-modernization-program). Netcracker said the suite automates the lead-to-cash process across billing, invoicing and revenue processes, which makes customer and revenue systems a likely evidence source to request in the intake conversation (https://www.netcracker.com/news/press-releases/netcracker-and-vivacom-extend-long-term-partnership-for-innovative-it-modernization-program). (bears on: baseline data & measurement access)

Communications pattern. The banked record makes a new pattern visible: Vivacom's owned corporate and social record carries scale, innovation, CSR, talent and offers, while independent signals show uneven response, with strong Instagram response, weak YouTube response, low-response PR volume, app complaints and a Trustpilot warning signal (banked findings: Tone of voice; Presence; Community). (bears on: reputation problem / desired perception)

Channels. My Vivacom is distributed beyond Google Play and the Apple App Store; Vivacom says users can install it from Google Play, App Store or Huawei AppGallery, and can register either inside the app or through the web version of My Vivacom (https://www.vivacom.bg/my-vivacom-app).

Channels. Happy Call is both a mobile app and a web route; Vivacom says users can open happycall.bg from phone or desktop, activate by SMS START to 1520, and stop by SMS STOP or in the app profile (https://www.vivacom.bg/dopalnitelni-uslugi/zabavlenie/happy-call).

Channels. Vivacom gives customers a Google Play carrier-billing route. Its owned page says users can add Vivacom billing in Google Play, pay for apps or subscriptions through their monthly Vivacom bill, and receive SMS verification from 1988 (https://www.vivacom.bg/dopalnitelni-uslugi/zabavlenie/google-play).
Presence. Happy Call had 100K+ Google Play downloads, a Teen rating, in-app purchases and a 27 July 2026 update date (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=bg.allterco.fcm).

Presence. The Happy Call Google Play listing names VIVACOM Bulgaria as developer, gives happycall@vivacom.bg as support email, and links to a separate privacy policy at policy.teracomm.bg (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=bg.allterco.fcm).

Presence. Pay by Vivacom's owned page shows the wallet as an active consumer-service presence, with household-bill payment, card controls, payment notifications, virtual debit card, personal IBAN, transfers between app users and point-of-sale payment listed on the page (https://www.vivacom.bg/drugi-uslugi/digitalen-portfeil).

Tone of voice. Happy Call's product voice is casual and entertainment-led; Vivacom uses the exact phrases "Посрещни всеки с песен" and "Супер апликация за твоя телефон!" for caller-ring personalization (https://www.vivacom.bg/dopalnitelni-uslugi/zabavlenie/happy-call).

Tone of voice. Happy Call's Google Play copy uses self-expression language, saying the app has more than 3,000 songs and calling the service "Your music message for everyone who's calling you" (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=bg.allterco.fcm).

Tone of voice. Pay by Vivacom's headline voice is ease-and-control led; Vivacom says, exactly, "Правим финансите по-лесни, достъпни и открити" (https://www.vivacom.bg/drugi-uslugi/digitalen-portfeil).

Tone of voice. Vivacom's Google Play carrier-billing page uses safety and convenience language, saying users can shop without giving bank-card details and pay later through the monthly Vivacom bill; no independent source opened in this pass tested that user-experience claim (https://www.vivacom.bg/dopalnitelni-uslugi/zabavlenie/google-play).

Community. Vivacom's 30 July 2025 GAME ON update says the first online round drew more than 530 players, ran live for more than four hours across seven channels on YouTube and Twitch, and gave two finalists BGN 1,000 each (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/nad-500-igrachi-se-borikha-za-myasto-na-finala-v-parviya-onlain-rund-na-vivacom-game-on-2025).

Community. The same GAME ON update says every viewer in the 2025 online rounds could play and compete for a BGN 1,000 cash prize, with winners moving toward the 1 November live final (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/nad-500-igrachi-se-borikha-za-myasto-na-finala-v-parviya-onlain-rund-na-vivacom-game-on-2025).
Community. Happy Call includes a gifting mechanic; Vivacom lists "Подари песен на приятел" as the fourth service step (https://www.vivacom.bg/dopalnitelni-uslugi/zabavlenie/happy-call).

Community. Vivacom had a startup-support community route as early as 2015; Connect Europe published Janet Zaharieva saying VIVA START and #newbornideas gave winners funding, billing-system revenue, marketing support, mentoring, free mobile services and VIVA Apps placement (https://connecteurope.org/news/etno-thinkdigital-interview-bulgarian-telcos-perspective-stimulating-innovative-ideas-local).

The visibility of its executives. United Group says Janet Zaharieva became Group Director Public Policy and Corporate Affairs in July 2026 while continuing to lead public policy and European affairs at Vivacom (https://united.group/leadership/janet-zaharieva/).

The visibility of its executives. United Group says Janet Zaharieva has 28 years in communications, media and ICT, has been part of Vivacom leadership since 2010, and represents United Group on the Connect Europe Executive Board and the GSMA Europe Policy Group (https://united.group/leadership/janet-zaharieva/).

The visibility of its executives. Connect Europe published a 2015 interview with Janet Zaharieva as Chief Regulatory Advisor to Vivacom's Managing Board, making her visible in policy debate around telecom regulation, broadband, startups and digital services (https://connecteurope.org/news/etno-thinkdigital-interview-bulgarian-telcos-perspective-stimulating-innovative-ideas-local).

The visibility of its executives. United Group said on 3 November 2022 that Janet Zaharieva would represent the group on the ETNO board for three years after ETNO's general assembly in Skopje (https://united.group/united-group-becomes-member-of-the-executive-board-of-etno/).

Digital privacy scope. Vivacom's privacy policy covers its websites, mobile apps, online forms, subscriptions, products, services and controlled social-media channels when they link to that policy. It says Vivacom may process customer-service chat, browsing behavior, marketing-message response and device identifiers (https://www.vivacom.bg/protection-and-policy). (bears on: constraints and guardrails -- what cannot be said, claimed or processed)

Digital wallet role. Pay by Vivacom extends the brand into financial services. Vivacom says it gives users mobile payments, peer transfers, bill payment, online shopping through a virtual debit card, credit up to 2,045.17 euros, electronic vignettes and loyalty-card storage (https://www.vivacom.bg/pomosht/chesto-zadavani-vuprosi/finansovi-uslugi-i-funktsii/kakvo-e-pay-by-vivacom-kak-da-polzvam-elektronniya-portfeil-na-vivacom). (bears on: programme, narrative and channels -- the story, the spokespeople, what has worked)

Customer loyalty route. Vivacom Club is a digital loyalty card inside My Vivacom for private customers with at least six months of subscription and regular payment. Vivacom says it gives discounts in Vivacom and more than 100 partner locations across Bulgaria (https://www.vivacom.bg/dopalnitelni-uslugi/vivacom-club). (bears on: audience and insight -- who matters, what they know and feel today, what would change it)

Channel pattern. The banked record shows a wider product-channel pattern: Vivacom's digital presence spans account care, TV, gaming, finance, caller music and partner channels, not only corporate pages and social feeds (banked findings: Channels; EON platform provenance; Customer and revenue systems; Community). (bears on: programme, narrative and channels -- the story, the spokespeople, what has worked)

Channels. The banked record shows a three-operator attention contest: Vivacom, A1 and Yettel are tracked on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube, while TikTok was negligible across the three in Q1 2026 (banked findings: Channels; Presence).

Channels. Vivacom opened Vivacom Support on Viber at the start of March 2023 for direct customer questions, bill checks, payments and service information (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/vivacom-veche-e-vav-viber).

Channels. Vivacom called Viber its fourth fast digital customer-service channel after Facebook Messenger, chat on the official site and self-care chat in the web version of MyVivacom (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/vivacom-veche-e-vav-viber).
Channels. Viber's own public page confirms a Vivacom Support public account exists (https://chats.viber.com/vivacomsupport).

Channels. Nixanbal reported the Viber Support channel and said users would communicate with real people rather than a chatbot (https://nixanbal.com/vivacom-puska-viber-kanal-za-poddrazhka-na-klienti/).

Channels. The contacts page gives contact form, shop finder, customer-service number 123, My Vivacom profile, Vivacom Support, media email and central-office address as customer or media routes (https://www.vivacom.bg/pomosht/kontakti).

Channels. The mobile plans page makes vivacom.bg a sales channel by saying the online monthly fee is the lowest compared with Vivacom's other sales channels for the stated new mobile-contract offer (https://www.vivacom.bg/mobilni-uslugi/mobilni-planove).
Channels. Vivacom Arena is presented as a set of own TV channels inside EON packages, with Arena Action, Arena Comedy and Arena Life forming Arena Select (https://www.vivacom.bg/eon-tv/arena).
Presence. Similarweb estimated vivacom.bg at 1.6 million visits and ranked it second in the Telecommunications category in June 2026 (https://www.similarweb.com/website/vivacom.bg/).

Presence. Similarweb estimated that vivacom.bg traffic fell 8.18% month on month, with a 51.31% bounce rate, 3.63 pages per visit and an average visit duration of 3 minutes 20 seconds (https://www.similarweb.com/website/vivacom.bg/).

Presence. Similarweb estimated that Bulgaria supplied 93.46% of desktop traffic to vivacom.bg, followed by the United States at 1.59%, Germany at 0.98%, the United Kingdom at 0.72% and France at 0.45% (https://www.similarweb.com/website/vivacom.bg/).
Presence. Similarweb estimated that direct traffic supplied 51.03% of desktop visits to vivacom.bg, with organic search second and paid search third (https://www.similarweb.com/website/vivacom.bg/).
Presence. Similarweb said vivacom.bg gets most of its social traffic from Facebook, followed by YouTube (https://www.similarweb.com/website/vivacom.bg/).
Presence. OpenSubSub listed Vivacom's YouTube channel at 15.3K subscribers, 72.8M total views and 1.5K videos (https://open.subsub.io/channels/vivacomofficial/view).
Presence. OpenSubSub says the Vivacom YouTube channel was created on 11 April 2011 and publishes in Bulgarian (https://open.subsub.io/channels/vivacomofficial/view).

Presence. The EON 5G Home Net page lists EON Smart Box, EON Smart TV app, EON mobile app, 20,000-plus video-library titles and 180-plus channels in the shown EON Full package (https://www.vivacom.bg/eon/5g-eon-zero-start).

Tone of voice. Vivacom's Viber launch uses customer-closeness language, saying customers can contact the company quickly, easily and conveniently through their preferred communication platform (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/vivacom-veche-e-vav-viber).

Tone of voice. Vivacom's Viber launch says, exactly, "Vivacom поставя клиентите си в центъра на всичко, което прави"; Nixanbal reported the service launch but did not test whether the service experience supports that claim (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/vivacom-veche-e-vav-viber; https://nixanbal.com/vivacom-puska-viber-kanal-za-poddrazhka-na-klienti/).
Tone of voice. Vivacom's careers headline says, exactly, "Започваш работа, получаваш кариера", which makes the employer voice direct and promise-led (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/karieri).
Tone of voice. Vivacom's careers page says, exactly, "Започваш работа. Получаваш свобода.", which gives the employer story a personal-growth frame (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/karieri).

Tone of voice. Vivacom's brand page is rule-led rather than campaign-led, giving logo form, spacing, contrast and corporate-colour rules for digital and print use (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/markata-vivacom).

Tone of voice. Vivacom's mobile-sales page says, exactly, "Най-добрата ни оферта е на vivacom.bg"; no independent source opened in this pass tested whether that price claim held across all Vivacom sales routes (https://www.vivacom.bg/mobilni-uslugi/mobilni-planove).
Tone of voice. Vivacom Arena uses a compact entertainment line, exactly, "Четири свята. Една сцена.", to frame four Arena channel worlds as one family offer (https://www.vivacom.bg/eon-tv/arena).

Community. The Viber Support route turns community handling into a service conversation, because customers can ask questions, check bills and receive service information inside Viber (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/vivacom-veche-e-vav-viber).

Community. Nixanbal reported that Vivacom Support on Viber is handled by the customer-care team and uses real people rather than a chatbot (https://nixanbal.com/vivacom-puska-viber-kanal-za-poddrazhka-na-klienti/).
Community. Vivacom's careers page says the company has about 5,000 people, staff in more than 140 settlements and nearly 50 interns each year (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/karieri).
Community. Vivacom's careers page links to YouTube staff-story videos, so employer community content is not limited to LinkedIn and the newsroom (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/karieri).
Community. Vivacom's careers page says its Technical Academy gives real skills under experienced experts and can lead graduates into the Vivacom team (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/karieri).

Community. Glassdoor shows mixed public candidate narratives despite a positive overall interview label, including one March 2025 positive incident-management interview and one April 2024 negative internship interview (https://www.glassdoor.com/Interview/Vivacom-Interview-Questions-E307239.htm).

The visibility of its executives. Silvia Georgieva, then customer-service director, is quoted on Vivacom's Viber launch saying Viber followed Facebook Messenger, website chat and MyVivacom self-care chat as a fast customer-service route (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/vivacom-veche-e-vav-viber).

The visibility of its executives. Nixanbal repeated Silvia Georgieva's customer-service quote in its coverage of the Viber Support launch (https://nixanbal.com/vivacom-puska-viber-kanal-za-poddrazhka-na-klienti/).

The visibility of its executives. Silviya Georgieva's public LinkedIn search result identifies her as Chief Customer Officer at Vivacom and frames her profile around teams, customer relationships and continuous improvement (https://bg.linkedin.com/in/silviya-georgieva-676461ab).

The visibility of its executives. Elitsa Georgieva, corporate communications director at Vivacom, is quoted on the Job Lab programme as a continuation of Vivacom's youth-development support (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/silen-start-na-programata-job-lab-na-vivacom-nasochena-kam-umeniyata-za-badeshteto).

The visibility of its executives. Elitsa Georgieva's public LinkedIn search result says she has been Corporate Communications Director at Vivacom since September 2022 (https://bg.linkedin.com/in/elitsa-georgieva-14709097).

The visibility of its executives. The Viber, Job Lab and banked executive findings create a new pattern: Vivacom's non-CEO visibility is strongest when leaders explain customer care, employer brand, youth skills and public policy, while network and ownership stories still centre more often on CEO or parent-group voices (banked findings: The visibility of its executives; https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/vivacom-veche-e-vav-viber; https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/silen-start-na-programata-job-lab-na-vivacom-nasochena-kam-umeniyata-za-badeshteto).

Digital Services Act contact route. Vivacom lists dsacompliance@vivacom.bg as its Article 11 contact under Regulation 2022/2065 and says this route can be used in Bulgarian and English (https://www.vivacom.bg/pomosht/kontakti). The same page says that address is not for marketing, subscriber complaints or other non-DSA purposes (https://www.vivacom.bg/pomosht/kontakti). (bears on: constraints and guardrails -- what cannot be said, claimed or processed)

Bulsatcom and TV platform context. United Group completed the Bulsatcom acquisition on 27 February 2024 and described Bulsatcom as a direct-to-home satellite TV and broadband internet provider in Bulgaria (https://www.vivacom.bg/za-nas/novini/united-group-compretes-the-acquisition-of-bulsatcom). Broadband TV News reported that the combined company would account for around 60% of Bulgaria's pay-TV market by subscriber count (https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2024/02/19/bulgaria-approves-united-groups-takeover-of-bulsatscom/). SeeNews reported on 19 February 2026 that Bulgaria's Supreme Administrative Court gave final clearance for United Group's acquisition of Bulsatcom telecom infrastructure assets after appeals from A1 Bulgaria, Yettel Bulgaria and Cetin Bulgaria (https://seenews.com/news/bulgarias-supreme-court-clears-united-groups-acquisition-of-bulsatcom-1290035). (bears on: programme, narrative and channels -- the story, the spokespeople, what has worked)

Business messaging and customer-service data route. Vivacom's business Omnichannel page says its solution supports bulk SMS, Viber messages and email through a web interface (https://www.vivacom.bg/business/omnichannel). The same page says the offer includes contact-centre and chatbot solutions and feedback emails for Net Promoter Score, making campaign response and customer-service data a live intake request (https://www.vivacom.bg/business/omnichannel). (bears on: baseline data & measurement access)

Employer-platform signals. Indeed lists Vivacom's employer page as unclaimed, with a 3.4 out of 5 rating and 17 reviews (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Vivacom). Glassdoor lists eight Vivacom interview entries, an average difficulty label and a very positive interview-experience label, with 100% of shown candidates applying online (https://www.glassdoor.com/Interview/Vivacom-Interview-Questions-E307239.htm). (bears on: audience and insight -- who matters, what they know and feel today, what would change it)

Channels. I did not establish an official TikTok account for Vivacom Bulgaria from accessible public sources.
Presence. I did not find public first-party reach, impressions, audience split or conversion data for Vivacom’s owned and social channels.
Presence. I did not find public access to Vivacom’s paid-media spend, campaign results, web analytics, CRM data or social-listening baseline.
Tone of voice. I did not find a public full voice guide beyond logo and visual-brand rules on the Vivacom brand page.
Tone of voice. I did not find public evidence that Vivacom has one approved corporate narrative above product, employer, social-responsibility and gaming content.
Community. I did not find a public Vivacom-owned response-rate, complaint-resolution or social sentiment report.
Community. I did not find public evidence that Vivacom’s education and environmental programmes have shifted trust, affinity or preference.
The visibility of its executives. I did not find a current active public personal social profile for Asen Velikov that is clearly used as an executive communication channel.
The visibility of its executives. I did not find a regular public CEO interview series, executive blog or executive newsroom section separate from company posts and event appearances.

Channels. A reliable current follower count for any official Vivacom TikTok account was not established; public sources found TikTok as a GAME ON streaming venue, not a verified owned-account audience count.
Channels. No public source opened in this pass established an official Vivacom Threads account.
Tone of voice. No independent source opened in this pass tested Vivacom's qualitative Happy Call words such as "Супер апликация"; they are usable as tone evidence only.
Channels. No opened public source gave current follower, subscriber or response figures for Vivacom Support on Viber.
Channels. No opened public source confirmed whether Vivacom has a current official TikTok account with material activity after the Q1 2026 Pikasa finding that TikTok presence was negligible.
Presence. Similarweb labels its data as estimated, so Vivacom's own analytics are still needed before using these figures as campaign or reputation baselines.
Presence. No opened public source gave current aggregate usage for My Vivacom, EON, Pay by Vivacom, Happy Call and Viber Support in one comparable dataset.
Tone of voice. No opened public source gave a downloadable current Vivacom tone guide beyond logo, colour and use rules on the brand page.
Tone of voice. No opened independent source tested Vivacom's customer-first wording against measured customer-care performance on Viber, website chat or MyVivacom self-care chat.
Community. No opened public source gave Vivacom-owned community-management rules for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Viber or app-store replies.
Community. No opened public source gave response-time, resolution-rate or sentiment data for Vivacom's social-service routes.
